correctness.rationale: From the five exact cyclic derivatives, products exclude every prime except 3 and 11; in characteristic three the critical points have nonzero F. In characteristic eleven, elimination exhibits F4=(u^11-3)/u^5 and F=2(u^11-3)/u^10, yielding the full singular algebra F11[t]/(t^11). Hessian rank 3 is directly checked; isolated support gives normal geometrically integral hypersurface. A standalone verifier checks calculations but no infinite conclusion relies on finite sampling.
